# The -1 Guarantee

The -1 Guarantee is a Substack publication by Massimiliano Banini about Negative Price Guarantees, ultra-guarantees, risk reversal, seller accountability, pricing, customer trust, operational measurement, business ethics, and measurable outcomes.

## Canonical publication

- https://theminusoneguarantee.substack.com/

## Discovery files

- Full readable archive: https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/archive.html
- XML sitemap: https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/sitemap.xml
- Text sitemap: https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/sitemap.txt
- Structured JSON: https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/articles.json
